title: Hodge numbers of moduli of principal bundles on a curve
summary: We prove an inversion theorem for recursive formulas satisfied by certain families of converging power series in two variables. These power series are indexed by the Harder-Narasimhan types of principal $G$-bundles of degree $d \in π_1 G$ on a smooth projective curve $X$, where $G$ is a connected complex reductive group. As an application, we obtain a closed formula for the Hodge-Poincaré series of moduli stacks of semistable principal $G$-bundles of degree $d$.
